title: FrameMeta
description: Fields of a Redis frames:{cam_id} entry except `data` (the JPEG bytes), interfaces-v1 §5.2. Redis stores every field as a string; trophy.framebus parses them. The phone->gateway WS message is a 16-byte little-endian header (u8 version=1, u8 flags, u16 reserved, u32 seq, f64 t_capture_phone_ms) followed by the JPEG (§5.1).

flags.description: bit0 calibration still, bit1 first frame after (re)start
